scripts.build: npm run sdk:build && npm run typecheck && npm run extension:examples:check && npm run frontend:bundle
scripts.extension:hello:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.hello && npm run build --workspace sideral.hello
scripts.extension:markdown:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.markdown-preview && npm run build --workspace sideral.markdown-preview
scripts.extension:amxx:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.amxx-pawn && npm run test --workspace sideral.amxx-pawn && npm run build --workspace sideral.amxx-pawn && npm run extension:tool -- check extensions/amxx-pawn
scripts.extension:discord:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.discord-presence && npm run test --workspace sideral.discord-presence && npm run build --workspace sideral.discord-presence && npm run extension:tool -- check extensions/discord-presence
scripts.extension:examples:check: npm run extension:hello:check && npm run extension:markdown:check && npm run extension:amxx:check && npm run extension:discord:check
scripts.security: npm run security:npm && npm run security:rust
scripts.check: npm run architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run sdk:build && npm run extension:examples:check && npm run test && npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test && npm run frontend:bundle && npm run security
